structured_output.summary: Added a pure ASGI RequestBodyLimitMiddleware and MAX_BODY_SIZE_SCOPE_KEY in starlette/middleware/body_limit.py, plus tests in tests/middleware/test_body_limit.py. Nothing was run in this session; the harness result is the first check.

criteria_notes.note: test_rejects_body_over_limit_without_content_length: a chunked generator body over the limit returns a plain-text 413 'Content Too Large'.

test_multipart_upload_counts_overhead (250-byte file under a 300-byte limit is rejected because of boundary overhead) and test_streaming_body_counted_per_chunk. The multipart sizes are estimated, not measured.

test_understated_content_length_and_exact_limit: an exact-limit body is accepted, and an understated header with an 11-byte body gets 413. test_invalid_content_length_is_ignored covers the unparseable-header branch.

test_no_double_response: after response.start has been sent, crossing the limit sends nothing more and HTTPException(413) is raised. test_other_http_exception_propagates covers the non-limit exception branch.

test_scope_key_set_and_restored: the key is set inside the app and restored afterwards, with and without a previous value, including after the app raises. test_non_http_scope_passes_through covers the non-http branch.
The middleware is pure ASGI and exports MAX_BODY_SIZE_SCOPE_KEY. test_not_exported_from_package_root checks that neither name is on the starlette package root.
